column1: # Chronic waterlogging spots in Mumbai — HAND-SEEDED reference layer.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: there is no clean public API for Mumbai's chronic
# flooding spots. BMC/MCGM publishes lists in reports and press coverage
# IIT Bombay's flood system is a web portal rather than a feed. So this list is
# HOW IT MUST BE PRESENTED: as "historically floods here"
# Live status comes only from community reports
# ACCURACY CAVEAT: coordinates are approximate junction/landmark centroids
# (~100-300m). They are good enough to warn "this area floods" and NOT good
# enough to claim a specific lane is under water. Before any public launch
# verify each against OpenStreetMap and correct. Treat this as a seed
# severity: severe | moderate  (severe = recurrent knee-deep-or-worse reporting)
